sources: TT Electronics (BI Technologies) P160 Series panel potentiometer, issue C (06/2021), LCSC's copy for C6249449 https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/01ead58744deb67a1c53d901897cbb62.pdf?productCode=C6249449, read 2026-11-03 (its tables are images, read from the pages)

p. 1 ordering scheme: P160, KN = side adjust with PC pins, 0 = no detent, Q-type shaft, C = full-CCW position, shaft length 15, taper B (B = linear), the total resistance 1K; p. 3: standard values 100 Ω … 1 MΩ, 1K among them

p. 2: ±20 % resistance tolerance, power rated 0.2 W (B taper) and 0.1 W (others), operating temperature −20 … +70 °C; p. 3 circuit diagram: CCW end, S (the wiper), CW end – pins 1, 2, 3 as the design's symbol Device:R_Potentiometer_US (2 the wiper)
JLCPCB catalogue 2026-11-03 (edakit part search): C6249449 P160KN-0QC15B1K, TT Electronics, Extended Part, no stock

stand-in: the schematic names the value and taper (POT2 B1K, 'Fuzz') and a board-mounted 16 mm footprint (random_input:Potentiometer_Single_3_Horizontal), not a maker – the P160 is the open designs' pot (guitarml-ts-rat-combo)
